;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2017–18 Iranian protests]]
**A peaceful protest over a [[Water crisis in Iran|water shortage]] in the [[southern Iran]] city of [[Khorramshahr]] turns violent after clashes between police and protesters. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/30/world/iran-water-protest-deatj/index.html (CNN)]
*[[List of incidents of civil unrest in the United States|Civil unrest in the United States]]
**A [[right-wing]] [[Patriot Prayer]] rally in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], [[Oregon]] turns violent, with clashes reported between the group and the [[left-wing]] group [[Antifa (United States)|Antifa]]. The [[Portland Police Bureau]] reports that four arrests were made for outstanding warrants, and that Patriot Prayer's permit to march was cancelled once the violence began. [https://www.npr.org/2018/07/01/625095869/police-declare-a-riot-after-far-right-and-antifa-groups-clash-in-portland (NPR)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/defend-pdx-patroit-prayer-portland-clash-today-2018-06-30/ (CBS News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Toronto]]
**Two persons are killed, and one injured, in a shooting in downtown [[Toronto]]. These are the 49th and 50th murders this year, marking a surge of violence in the city. [http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/toronto-police-downtown-shooting-1.4730300 (CBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Protests against Trump administration family separation policy]]
**Tens of thousands of people participate in nationwide protests across the [[United States]] over the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]'s [[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|immigration policies]]. Over 630 events are planned, with protesters calling for migrant families split at the [[Mexico–United States border|United States–Mexico border]] to be reunited.
